supportedExtensions.description: Enabled formats from the built-in document parsers. Adding an extension does not install a parser.

maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum source document size in MiB.

parserTimeoutMs.description: Maximum worker parsing time per document in milliseconds.

chunkSize.description: Maximum extracted chunk size in characters. Page, slide, sheet, and heading boundaries are preserved where available.

includeNotes.description: Include footnotes, endnotes, and presentation speaker notes.

enablePdfOcr.description: Transcribe pages without a text layer using local Poppler and Tesseract, including pages in mixed PDFs. Completed pages persist across parser deadlines and retries.

ocrLanguage.description: Installed Tesseract language codes, such as eng or eng+fra. No language data is downloaded.

enablePdfVision.description: Use the chat vision model to transcribe uncertain OCR pages, including handwriting. Completed page outputs are cached before embedding; their chunks are synthetic.

pdfVisionMinConfidence.description: OCR word confidence below which an enabled vision fallback transcribes the page.

summarizeDocuments.description: Generate an additional synthetic summary with the chat model before any embeddings.

summaryPrompt.description: Instruction for optional document summaries; options.customPrompt overrides this per request.
summaryPrompt.default: Summarize the main subjects, findings, and key details of this document.

summaryMaxChars.description: Maximum characters of source text supplied to the summary model. Truncation is recorded on the synthetic chunk.

summaryTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for each optional chat summary in milliseconds.

embeddingBatchSize.description: Maximum chunks per embedding request in Phase 2.

defaultEntityType.description: Graph entity type returned for the document.

defaultRelation.description: Graph edge relation from the document to its contextEntity.
